maddeler.e:
تحاربت (form VI)
# تَحَارَبْتُ (taḥārabtu) /ta.ħaː.rab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# تَحَارَبْتَ (taḥārabta) /ta.ħaː.rab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# تَحَارَبْتِ (taḥārabti) /ta.ħaː.rab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# تَحَارَبَتْ (taḥārabat) /ta.ħaː.ra.bat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
